evidence_notes.reentrancy: Question 6(d) executable attack implementation and local reentrancy reproduction are explicitly incomplete. No attack source or attack experiment is claimed. Question 6(e) contains a source-level CEI repair, not a claimed tested fixed-contract result. local-results.json covers storage and Hello World only.
evidence_notes.sepolia_wallet_execution: evidence/sepolia-results.json records a successful direct type-2 deployment and a verified successful type-2 retry using existing EIP-7702 delegation. The retry has status 1 in block 11940802, consumes 195438 gas for the whole wallet transaction, and contains one zero-value inner call to the deployed HelloWorld address with selector 0x19ff1d21 in default revert-on-failure mode. A separate eth_call returns exactly Hello, world!. The first type-4 attempt has status 0 and is archived separately in evidence/sepolia-failed-hello.json; no out-of-gas cause is asserted.
